create_robot_manager: create a RobotManager instance with a config and simulator to manage all robot instances in the scene
reconfigure_robots: reconfigure all robots in the manager when loading a new scene or resetting the environment
update_robots: update all robot instance managers and their grasp managers each simulation step
setup_ik_helper: call first_setup to initialize inverse kinematics helpers for robots with configured IK arm URDFs
iterate_robots: iterate over all robot interfaces or grasp managers using the robots_iter or grasp_iter properties
